definitions.explanation: A respectful title for doctors, lawyers, and experts.

⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先生|せんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やさしい→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先生|せんせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: That writer is famous, has written many books, and receives awards every year.
examples.notes: Also used for authors and artists

notes:
{先生|せんせい} is a respectful title for teachers, doctors, and other professionals.

USAGE AS TITLE:
- After names: {田中|たなか}{先生|せんせい} (Teacher/Dr. Tanaka)
- Direct address: {先生|せんせい}、⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。

APPLIES TO:
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: teachers
- ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧: doctors
- ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧: lawyers
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: authors, artists
- ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: politicians

IMPORTANT:
Never use {先生|せんせい} for yourself. Use ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧ or {教員|きょういん} instead.
